darwin.notes: macOS 1.2.5 build 132: fixes Project / EXACT FILES scope, search delays during audio analysis, and offline library status after reconnecting a drive. Adds clickable shortcut-bar entries that open matching Instructions, plus optional hover hints. Also includes REX preview and editing, RX2 drag export, vertical waveform zoom, and Project Audio Export.

win32.notes: Windows 1.2.5 build 265: keeps EXACT FILES scoped to the selected Project and restores that view when the filter is turned off. Prevents audio analysis from superseding search and library changes. Adds larger hover hints for bottom-bar shortcuts, a separate Show Shortcut Hints switch, and click-to-Instructions navigation. Includes REX/RX2 editing and drag export, Project Audio Export, waveform zoom, Ogg-in-WAV decoding, improved large-library navigation, and FFmpeg LGPL notices.
